verdict.rationale: Drata's developer portal hosts an OpenAPI-style reference (tag pages like Personnel, Devices, Controls, Risks) implying a spec exists, but direct probes for the machine-readable file (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known/openapi.json, llms.txt) all returned 404, meaning no confirmed downloadable spec was found. missing for 10: a verified downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger JSON or YAML file, and confirmation that the reference UI is backed by an accessible raw spec.
